title: B3 BUILD (control-plane): reputation.py Phase A read-only derivation, plus tests
description: Build the Phase A reputation reader: a NEW read-only CLI at .harness/bin/reputation.py that DERIVES standing at read time from existing stores, mirroring PR-010's computed-on-read doctrine. Section A.4 is the whole constraint: reputation is derived, never stored as balances; no new ledger; NO CONSEQUENCE ATTACHES, NONE. AB3 requires a fixed sybil caveat on every output path. AB2 requires per-figure source attribution and an adjudications field that ships PRESENT and EMPTY rather than fabricated. AB4 requires Phase A neutrality: no code path varies any verification or confirmation burden by standing, because section A.6.2's standing-scaled trust burden is Phase B material. AB9-1 requires that every consolidation figure display WHO confirmed, so the author-recruits-confirmers pattern is visible while it is still free to attempt - which is section A.4's stated purpose. Implement EXACTLY the surface fixed in docs/precedent-research/synthesis-addendum-ii-spec.md; an invented flag is a defect because T-372 must quote a frozen surface. Runs in parallel with T-370, which owns disjoint files.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY TWO NEW FILES: .harness/bin/reputation.py and .harness/tests/test_reputation.py. MUST NOT edit .harness/bin/precedent.py (T-370 owns it and runs concurrently), any test_precedent*.py file, PRECEDENT.md, INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md, any record, .harness/state.json, or any harness_common signature.

READ-ONLY, ABSOLUTELY: reputation.py writes NOTHING - no record, no event, no state, no cache, no lock, no temp file inside the repo. It is the same verb class as cite, conflicts and stale. No hc.log_event call anywhere in the file. PROVE IT with a test that hashes every store (each .harness/precedents/*.json, .harness/blackboard.json, .harness/state.json) and counts .harness/logs/events.jsonl lines before and after invoking EVERY subcommand on EVERY output path, asserting exact identity.

IMPLEMENT THE SPEC'S SURFACE VERBATIM: subcommands, flags, exit codes, greppable stdout line shapes, --json shape, with the requirement id cited in a comment per subcommand. No extra subcommand, no extra flag, no bonus feature - an invented surface is a REJECT, because T-372 quotes this surface into a tracked constitutional document and the drift lesson is twice-learned.

THE SYBIL CAVEAT ON EVERY OUTPUT PATH (AB3): the fixed caveat line, character-for-character as the spec quotes it - identities are self-asserted with FORCE-IDENTITY-A open, Phase A is bookkeeping and not currency, no consequence may cite these figures - on every subcommand, every exit path that prints figures, AND inside --json as the named field the spec fixes. One test per output path, including the error paths.

PER-FIGURE SOURCE ATTRIBUTION (AB2): every figure names the store it was derived from, in the exact attribution form the spec fixes. A figure with no attribution is a defect. Prefer registry and task records over raw events.jsonl counts (the log carries measured synthetic-token contamination, roughly 430 events); read events.jsonl ONLY where the spec authorizes it and say so in the output itself.

EMPTY, NEVER FABRICATED (AB2): the adjudications-not-reversed figure ships PRESENT and EMPTY with an explicit unavailable marker until the appellate verb exists. A fabricated number, a zero presented as a measurement, or a silently omitted field are all defects. Test it.

AB9-1 VISIBILITY: every consolidation figure displays WHO confirmed, from the field the spec names. Test it against two fixtures - one where the publisher and the confirmer are the same identity, one where they differ - and assert the display makes the difference visible.

PHASE A NEUTRALITY (AB4) AS CODE: no function, flag, threshold or output that varies any verification or confirmation burden by standing; nothing importable as a gate by another module. State this in the module docstring, and write a test asserting the module exposes no such function (an explicit allow-list of public callables is the cleanest form).

TEST ISOLATION: every test runs under the overridden root the spec fixes, with the spec's precedence (flag wins over environment variable), against fixture stores the test creates in a temp directory. Zero writes to any live store. Measure .harness/logs/events.jsonl line count before and after the suite and assert equality.
PYTHON 3.9.6, STDLIB ONLY, no 3.10+ syntax, no third-party imports. Reuse harness_common read helpers without changing any signature (other CLIs depend on them).

ACCEPTANCE COMMANDS (P-025), each quoted with its output: `python3 -m unittest discover -s .harness/tests -p "test_reputation*.py" -v` green with a 'Ran N tests' line where N >= 12; `python3 -m py_compile .harness/bin/reputation.py` exit 0; `python3 .harness/bin/reputation.py --help` exit 0; at least one REAL invocation against the live stores (safe, because it is read-only) with full stdout pasted including the caveat line, plus the same invocation with --json. AND `python3 -m unittest discover -s .harness/tests -p "test_precedent*.py" -v` must STILL be green with N >= 229 - you must not break the neighbour family.

RECORD-BEFORE-CODE (PR-017 procedure): quote the ids of the T-369 records that authorize this reader (the Phase A ledger-only record and the load-bearing-citation record) and show each active. Implement ONLY the MECHANIZABLE subset of the v1 heuristic from docs/precedent-research/13-load-bearing-citation.md as the spec delimits it, and print the JUDGMENT steps as not-computed rather than guessing them. A figure the stores cannot actually support is reported as unavailable, never estimated.

SCOPE REFUSALS, all testable: no stored balances and no new ledger; no consequence, weighting, gating or privilege; no reputation for humans in the loop (the operator is sovereign, not a market participant); no leaderboard across organizations; no automatic demotion or exclusion by computed standing; no write to state.json; no NLAH mutation; no duty imposed on any agent.

Hand off with `python3 .harness/bin/blackboard.py handoff --to-role verifier --agent <you>` (never self-mark done). The note carries: the --help output, one full real invocation with its caveat line, the store-immutability proof numbers, the events.jsonl before/after counts, and every OPEN-QUESTION - especially any figure the spec named that the stores cannot support, which you must name rather than fabricate.
